rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a legislature or a particular parliament such as a numbered term.

example.english: This parliament will discuss a new education bill today.
example.traditional: 呢個議會今日會討論新嘅教育法案。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ji5 wui6 gam1 jat6 wui5 tou2 leon6 san1 ge3 gaau3 juk6 faat3 on3

rows.note: Use this for a national parliament, including a particular numbered parliament or term.

example.english: The US parliament passed a new bill.
example.traditional: 美國國會通過咗新法案。
example.jyutping: mei5 gwok3 gwok3 wui6 tung1 gwo3 zo2 san1 faat3 on3

rows.note: Use this specifically for Hong Kong's legislature or one of its numbered terms.

example.english: The Hong Kong parliament will vote on this law next week.
example.traditional: 立法會下星期會表決呢條法例。
example.jyutping: laap6 faat3 wui6 haa6 sing1 kei4 wui5 biu2 kyut3 ni1 tiu4 faat3 lai6

rows.note: Use this more formal term for a legislative house or parliament, especially when distinguishing houses such as upper and lower chambers.

example.english: The upper and lower houses of parliament debated this amendment for several days.
example.traditional: 上議院同下議院就呢項修訂辯論咗幾日。
example.jyutping: soeng6 ji5 jyun2 tung4 haa6 ji5 jyun2 zau6 ni1 hong6 sau1 ding6 bin6 leon6 zo2 gei2 jat6
